commonPrompt: Create a high-quality original game SPRITE ATLAS, transparent RGBA background, square image. STRICT GRID: EXACTLY 7 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS, 28 separate full-body sprites, one sprite centered within each equally sized cell, generous clear transparent gutters, no character crosses a cell boundary. Each row is ONE consistent character in seven different poses, same outfit, same proportions and scale through its row. Columns left to right: (1) neutral ready idle facing three-quarter right, (2) walk stride left foot forward, (3) walk stride right foot forward, (4) distinct attack/casting WINDUP, (5) distinct attack/cast RELEASE aimed to the right, (6) joyful triumphant raised-arms victory pose, (7) defeated crouch/collapse, no gore. Fully show ears, hands, weapons, tails and feet in EVERY cell. Feet at consistent baseline; absolutely no merged/overlapping sprites. Polished anime RPG 3D-looking chibi characters with rich material shading, clean readable silhouettes, warm cinematic rim light, sharp detail at small size, coherent art direction. No words, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks, no background scenery, no UI, no cast shadows outside each sprite cell. Separate isolated transparent cutouts, not a contact sheet of illustrations.
